verdict.rationale: USCIS's public site lists a 'Case Status Online' tool to 'track the status of an immigration application, petition, or request' and links 'Check your case status' from the homepage. Online filers can also track cases in their account, and FOIA requests have status lookup by request number. The probe found a bot wall at egov.uscis.gov, but that concerns automated agents, not a founder using the public page, so it does not contradict the story. Missing for 10: detail on how the lookup works (e.g. receipt-number entry, what status details are shown, no login required), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the public tool works.
